shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement), fully simulated linked maps behaving as ONE BIG MAP: live plumb see-below view with in-place selection and item-count/quality overlays, biome-driven sky plateaus, full cross-level parity, priority-aware work, bulk hauling compat (PUAH/Hauler's Dream) + Allow Tool priority hauling, probe-gated robot migration, wide stairs, elevators, TRUE through-gap combat, pod transit + AA, opt-in threats, world integration, Ancient Urban Ruins guard, self-testing harness, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and every compat/order reads + behaves as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (x/z identity, altitude drop only), dim slider. Things shrink about own center (belowThingScale).
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant exception); outermost ring AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: real probe required (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**: semantic anchor rule.
- **FORCED-ORDER PARITY PATTERN**: "Bring {thing} and {verb}" for sites lacking a thing the pawn's level has.
- **NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY**: every order reads as base game.
- **SEAMLESS CONTINUATION DOCTRINE**: every arrival continuation self-heals.
- **CAMERA LEVEL LOCK = HARD**: while locked, ALL automatic level switches blocked at the Game.CurrentMap setter. Column-scoped.
- **IsPlayerHome column identity** (ColumnAsHome): pocket levels report the ground map's home verdict (stands down inside AlertsReadout scope + QuestGen). Load-bearing for hauling-mod compat (Hauler's Dream gates on map.IsPlayerHome).
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair art. **PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP** (docs/).
- **FOREIGN-MAP ELIGIBILITY GATE**: z-levels can be excluded from foreign special maps. First consumer: Ancient Urban Ruins submaps (see Compat). Gate is fail-open — a map we cannot positively identify stays eligible. Two choke points: PlaceWorker_ABStairs (UX reject) + LevelMapGen.GetOrGenerate (belt-and-suspenders).

## BUILDING ART (stairs/ladders/elevator — AB_Stairs.xml) — FINALIZED 2026-07-23
- Directional art set: `_north/_east/_south` for stairs, grand stairs, ladders; elevator is `Things/Building/AB_Elevator_AB_Elevator` (Graphic_Single). No `_west` anywhere -> Graphic_Multi auto-mirrors east.
- **ARCHITECT ICON POLICY: NO `uiIconPath` on the stair defs.** RimWorld auto-derives the build-menu icon from the SOUTH face. Vertical conduit keeps vanilla `PowerConduit_MenuIcon`.
- **BAKED drawSize + per-facing offsets** folded into def XML for six defs; AB_LadderUp/AB_GrandStairsDown/AB_Elevator intentionally left on defaults. Dev art tuner removed once baked.

## SEE-BELOW view — rendering + interaction (BelowSelection / LevelRenderer / BelowThingOverlays)
Plumb one-way mirror: SectionLayer_ABBelowThings reprints the lower map's map-mesh things per open-air cell; live pawns via DrawPos altitude-shift + PawnDrawParms shrink. Select in place, double-click select-all-of-type, below overlays (GUI stack counts/quality + world-space forbid icons via reflected overlayHandles). Fail-open.

## HAULING MOD COMPAT (Scope B) — PUAH + HD user-verified
ABInventoryHaulBridge (reflection) → CrossLevelHaulJob.Build (bulk vs single) → JobDriver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels + WorkGiver. Allow Tool urgent hauling crosses first.

## ANCIENT URBAN RUINS COMPAT (AncientUrbanRuinsCompat.cs) — added 2026-07-23
- Host: `XMB.AncientUrbanrUins.MO` (Ancient urban ruins by MO). Detected via ABDetect (postfix-insensitive). Reflection only; no foreign types in signatures; fail-open.
- AUR's explorable maps are pocket maps (`AncientMarket_Libraray.MapParent_Custom : PocketMapParent`, biome AM_UndergroundSpace) reached by AUR's OWN MapEntrance/MapExit/AMMapPortal portal system; many are `isTemporary` (ShouldRemoveMapNow). AUR's own `Level*` types (LevelSchedule / Tab_LevelPower / PawnColumnWorker_AllowLevel) are a power/timetable feature — NOT z-levels, no collision.
- **Direction A shipped (defensive exclusion, opt-in override).** `IsUrbanRuinsMap(map)` = map.Parent is instance of MapParent_Custom (cached Type via AccessTools.TypeByName). `BlocksLevels(map)` = AUR active AND is-AUR-submap AND !settings.allowLevelsOnUrbanRuins. By default the stair PlaceWorker rejects placement (AB_NoLevelsUrbanRuins) and LevelMapGen.GetOrGenerate refuses, so no sky/basement can be stacked on a temporary exploration submap (which would orphan a pocket map).
- Setting `allowLevelsOnUrbanRuins` (default OFF) opts in — treats AUR submaps as normal column ground. Removal safety for the opt-in case is ALREADY handled by vanilla: AB_Sky/AB_Basement generators set `pocketMapProperties.destroyOnParentMapAbandoned=true`, and Game.DeinitAndRemoveMap destroys child pocket maps whose sourceMap == the removed map — so tearing down the AUR submap tears down our levels. No bespoke removal hook needed.
- Existing world/home patches (ColumnWorld.Tile, PlayerWealth/Pawns, IsPlayerHome) already ignore AUR pocket maps (they gate on our LevelComp.level != 0; an AUR submap carries a level-0 comp pointing at itself). No misfire.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API. PUAH/HD bulk hauling + Allow Tool urgent hauling tested good.

## SETTINGS — SEVEN tabs: Generation / View and camera / Work and logistics / Job scanning / Combat and threats / **Compat (NEW)** / Advanced.
- Compat tab (index 5): per-mod integration options; each section shows only when its host mod is loaded; "none detected" fallback note. First entry: Ancient urban ruins → `allowLevelsOnUrbanRuins` toggle. Tab arrays sized 7, ResetCompat added, scribed as `allowLevelsOnUrbanRuins`.
- View tab: below item-count + world overlays toggle; jobs tab presets + cadence.

## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified). **Hauler's Dream + Pick Up And Haul (bulk inventory hauling spans levels; single-carry fallback; user-verified). Allow Tool priority hauling. Ancient urban ruins (XMB.AncientUrbanrUins.MO): z-levels excluded from AUR exploration submaps by default, opt-in via Compat tab; removal-safe via destroyOnParentMapAbandoned.** Achtung! drags. Reverse Commands. Giddy-up / Vehicle Framework (routing exclusions). Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (UI, fail-open). All inert without host. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: ANCIENT URBAN RUINS COMPAT (direction A) shipped + new Compat settings tab. New AncientUrbanRuinsCompat module (detection + reflected MapParent_Custom identity + BlocksLevels gate, fail-open). Stair PlaceWorker + LevelMapGen refuse levels on AUR submaps unless opted in; `allowLevelsOnUrbanRuins` toggle (default off) on the new Compat tab. Removal safety free via existing destroyOnParentMapAbandoned on AB_Sky/AB_Basement. Build green (0 warn/0 err). NOT yet in-game tested. Earlier 2026-07-23: BUILDING ART FINALIZED; see-below overlays (GUI + world-space); double-click select-all; PUAH/HD bulk + Allow Tool urgent verified. Outstanding chores: in-game verify AUR gate (placement reject + opt-in build/teardown), translation report audit, palette pin watch, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
